description: This Java class 'JpaRelationDao' implements the 'RelationDao' interface, providing data access methods for entity relations in a SQL database. It includes methods for finding, checking, saving, and deleting relations, as well as complex path queries, utilizing Spring Data repositories and JDBC templates.

classes.name: JpaRelationDao
classes.description: Data Access Object for managing entity relations in SQL database, implementing complex query and transaction methods.

methods.name: findAllByFrom
methods.description: Finds all relations originating from a specific entity, optionally filtered by relation type group.

methods.name: findAllByFromAndType
methods.description: Finds all relations from a specific entity with a specific relation type and group.

methods.name: findAllByTo
methods.description: Finds all relations targeting a specific entity, optionally filtered by relation type group.

methods.name: findAllByToAndType
methods.description: Finds all relations to a specific entity with a specific relation type and group.

methods.name: checkRelation
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if a relation exists between two entities with a specific type and group.

methods.name: getRelation
methods.description: Retrieves a specific relation between two entities.

methods.name: saveRelation
methods.description: Saves or updates a relation entity.

methods.name: saveRelations
methods.description: Saves or updates multiple relation entities.

methods.name: deleteRelation
methods.description: Deletes a specific relation between two entities.

methods.name: deleteOutboundRelations
methods.description: Deletes all outbound relations from a given entity.

methods.name: deleteInboundRelations
methods.description: Deletes all inbound relations to a given entity.

methods.name: findRuleNodeToRuleChainRelations
methods.description: Finds relations from rule nodes to rule chains of a specific type, limited by count.

methods.name: findByRelationPathQuery
methods.description: Performs a complex relation path query based on specified path levels and direction.
